tactics:
induction xs with
  | nil => intro i j h; simp at h
  | cons x xs ih => intro i j h; cases i with
    | zero => simp only [List.drop_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    | succ k => simp only [List.drop_succ_cons] at h ⊢; rw [ih]; simp only [Nat.succ_add, List.getElem_cons_succ]

intro i; induction i generalizing xs with
  | zero => intro j h; simp only [List.drop_zero, Nat.zero_add]
  | succ k ih => intro j h; cases xs with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons x xs => simp only [List.drop_succ_cons] at h ⊢; rw [ih]; simp only [Nat.succ_add, List.getElem_cons_succ]
intro i j h; induction xs generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all [Nat.succ_add]
